categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: display materials, pharmaceutical CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization), and electronic materials. The display materials segment includes OLED sublimation materials and liquid crystal monomers used in OLED and TFT-LCD panels. The pharmaceutical segment focuses on innovative drug intermediates and raw materials, mainly serving Japanese clients. The electronic materials segment involves high-end photoresist materials and related products for semiconductor and display panel industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include organic compound synthesis design, hydrogen isotope substitution reactions, novel catalytic coupling, high-efficiency isomerization, precise hydrogenation, enzyme-catalyzed stereoselective synthesis, microchannel continuous flow reactions, advanced chromatographic separation, halogen impurity control, chiral isomer impurity control, metal ion control, trace impurity analysis, and isotope analysis. The company has established a comprehensive industrial production system emphasizing process optimization, precise control, and scale-up from lab to mass production. It also integrates AI technology to enhance R&D efficiency and reduce trial costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading global and domestic display panel manufacturers and material suppliers, pharmaceutical companies mainly in Japan, and semiconductor photoresist manufacturers. End markets include consumer electronics such as TVs, smartphones, computers, automotive displays, and medical drug production. The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships with major international firms like Merck, JNC, DuPont, and Roche's subsidiary Chugai.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Xi'an, China, with subsidiaries and operations in multiple Chinese cities including Weinan, Pucheng, and Dali, as well as a wholly owned subsidiary in Japan. Its sales are both domestic and international, with overseas revenue primarily from Japan, Europe, and South Korea. The company is expanding its domestic market presence in China, especially in OLED materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the R&D, synthesis, and production of specialized organic new materials supplied to downstream display panel manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, and electronic material producers. It procures raw materials and intermediates from upstream suppliers and delivers customized materials directly or via designated agents to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining leadership in OLED sublimation materials, expanding domestic market share, advancing pharmaceutical raw material production and registration, and achieving breakthroughs in electronic materials, especially photoresist monomers and resins. The company emphasizes technology innovation, AI integration in R&D, talent development, process optimization, cost control, and ESG compliance. It also invests in new product development in amino acids, peptides, and deuterated drugs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the production and direct sales of customized specialized organic new materials to downstream customers. The company follows a 'make-to-order' production model based on customer orders and forecasts. Sales are primarily direct, with some products sold through designated agents in Japan and South Korea. Revenue streams include product sales in display materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, and electronic chemicals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in OLED sublimation materials and liquid crystal monomers with global advanced technology. It holds a strong market position with high customer stickiness and strategic supplier status. In pharmaceutical CDMO, it is a later entrant facing intense competition from established domestic and international firms but leverages its chemical synthesis expertise and close client cooperation. In electronic materials, it is growing but still behind leading domestic peers, focusing on high-end photoresist materials and aiming for market share gains through technology advancement.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.46 billion, a 20.74% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 251.7 million, up 87.6%. R&D investment was RMB 121 million, about 8.3% of revenue. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.4 billion with steady growth. It has demonstrated strong profitability improvement driven by cost control and product mix optimization. The company maintains a healthy balance sheet with a low asset-liability ratio of about 11%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized organic new materials with advanced synthesis and purification technologies ensuring superior product purity and stability. It offers rapid R&D response, high conversion of research to production, and precise impurity control, creating a competitive moat. Its leadership in deuterated OLED materials and strong partnerships with global industry leaders differentiate it. Continuous innovation, cost efficiency, and integrated ESG practices further enhance its value proposition.
